title: Goralski, Polonia, dance tutorial di Juancarlos Battilani

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains steps clearly while standing in front of the group, occasionally demonstrating movements. He breaks down the routine into manageable sections before having students practice along with music.

lesson_structure.note: Breakdown of the first step on the spot.
Breakdown of the bear step holding hands.
Breakdown of turning step with 1-2-3 counts.
Group practices the steps to music.

steps_taught.name: passo sul posto
steps_taught.description: Opening and closing on the spot

steps_taught.name: passo dell'orso
steps_taught.description: Bear step moving forward with curved back

what_works: Clear verbal breakdown of each step before dancing to music
what_hinders: Group blocks some camera angles during partner practice

quotes.text: vogliamo ballare una danza polacca simpatica delle montagne che si chiama Góralski

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates opening and closing steps on the spot facing the front.
Teacher and students move in a circle holding hands executing the bear step.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: footwork detail due to group occlusion

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining vocal rhythm imitations like 'ta-ta-ta' with physical demonstration before integrating music.
